adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes the associated `category_id` lookup and `PostCreator.new(..., category: category_id)` call, replacing the creation with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. This means existing `disqus:import` usages with `-c/--category` will now fail with an unknown option, and imports no longer apply the requested category or the prior explicit permalink raw preamble (now replaced by `TopicEmbed.import`'s different “Imported from” footer).
